criteria.statement: Only a validated owner may perform a channel-only rekey; all non-owner rotations and all Refoundings are refused before planning, key minting, custody writes or publication.
Refusals explain missing authority/compaction evidence and leave custody bytes and epochs unchanged, with no receipt, key mint, Store, relay AUTH/query or publish.
Demonstrate whether new-epoch compaction output contains the exact signed Grant pinned by a surviving delegated action, independently of authority-resolution implementation.
Document refused operations, accepted compromised-community availability cost, operator escalation and stage 2 evidence-availability scope.
